codeSnippet.caption: Robust data sanitation pipeline
codeSnippet.code:
def clean_dataset(df):
    # 1. Clean column names to snake_case
    df.columns = df.columns.str.strip().str.lower().str.replace(' ', '_')
    # 2. Parse dates with error coercion
    df['transaction_date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['transaction_date'], errors='coerce')
    # 3. Impute missing numericals with group median
    df['amount'] = df.groupby('category')['amount'].transform(
        lambda x: x.fillna(x.median())
    )
    # 4. Remove duplicate entries
    return df.drop_duplicates(subset=['id'], keep='last')

codeSnippet.caption: Cohort retention calculation matrix
codeSnippet.code:
# Calculate cohort index and retention rate
def get_cohort_matrix(df):
    df['OrderMonth'] = df['InvoiceDate'].dt.to_period('M')
    df['Cohort'] = df.groupby('CustomerID')['OrderMonth'].transform('min')
    cohort_data = df.groupby(['Cohort', 'OrderMonth'])['CustomerID'].nunique().reset_index()
    cohort_data['Period'] = (cohort_data['OrderMonth'] - cohort_data['Cohort']).apply(lambda x: x.n)
    return cohort_data.pivot(index='Cohort', columns='Period', values='CustomerID')

codeSnippet.caption: Conducting hypothesis tests with SciPy
codeSnippet.code:
from scipy import stats

# Independent two-sample t-test
group_a = df[df['variant'] == 'control']['spending']
group_b = df[df['variant'] == 'treatment']['spending']

t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(group_a, group_b, equal_var=False)
print(f'T-statistic: {t_stat:.4f}, p-value: {p_val:.4e}')
if p_val < 0.05:
    print('Reject null hypothesis: Significant difference detected!')

codeSnippet.caption: Scikit-Learn ColumnTransformer pipeline
codeSnippet.code:
from sklearn.compose import ColumnTransformer
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler, OneHotEncoder
from sklearn.impute import SimpleImputer
from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline

num_pipeline = Pipeline([
    ('imputer', SimpleImputer(strategy='median')),
    ('scaler', StandardScaler())
])

cat_pipeline = Pipeline([
    ('imputer', SimpleImputer(strategy='most_frequent')),
    ('encoder', OneHotEncoder(handle_unknown='ignore'))
])

preprocessor = ColumnTransformer(transformers=[
    ('num', num_pipeline, ['age', 'income', 'credit_score']),
    ('cat', cat_pipeline, ['employment_type', 'education'])
])

import numpy as np

# Encode hour of day into continuous 24-hr cyclical coordinates

codeSnippet.caption: Precision-Recall curve and optimal threshold selection
codeSnippet.code:
from sklearn.metrics import precision_recall_curve
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

y_probs = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
precisions, recalls, thresholds = precision_recall_curve(y_test, y_probs)

# Find threshold where recall is at least 0.85

projects.title: Biosensor Signal Processing & Stress Detection with AI
projects.problemStatement: Continuous physiological monitoring enables non-invasive mental health and stress assessment. Using time-series electrodermal activity (EDA) and skin temperature signals, build a machine learning model capable of distinguishing acute stress states from baseline physiological rest.
projects.datasetName: Wearable EDA & Temperature Sensor Signals (WESAD Protocol)
projects.datasetDescription: High-frequency sensor stream recordings annotated with psychological stress protocol labels.
stepByStepInstructions: Filter and smooth raw biometric sensor streams using butterworth low-pass filters.
Segment continuous signals into 30-second sliding windows with 50% overlap.
Extract statistical features per window: Mean, Standard Deviation, Min/Max, Peak Count, and Spectral Energy.
Apply PCA (Principal Component Analysis) to visualize physiological cluster separation in 2D space.
Train an ensemble classifier (Random Forest) to predict stress states.
Evaluate model performance across user-independent leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) validation.
expectedOutput: Feature extraction script transforming raw continuous signals into tabular matrices
PCA 2D projection scatter plot showing baseline vs stress separation
Confusion matrix and classification report across independent test subjects
Technical writeup linking findings to UN Sustainable Development Goal 3 (Good Health and Well-being)
